comparison.objective: Close the unsafe wide dispenser opening, invert the bottle, open the perforated side, and season food within a dose limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulates flip covers, reorients a bottle, and sprinkles rigid grains; no fine tool seating, captive fastener, moving-socket reacquisition, or damper tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seasoning on the steak at no more than 2 g; it does not measure impact energy, damper travel, rebound, force, setting retention, or guarded test cycles.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is safe granular dispensing, meaningfully different from mechanically locking and dynamically commissioning an adjustable shock absorber. The record lacks a separate task spec and detailed cover tolerances, but its complete body establishes the distinction.
